pages.text_excerpt: Our values | Agape Unlimited Foundation Skip to content Agape Unlimited Foundation Our mission What we do Our values Get involved Contact Donate Our mission What we do Our values Get involved Contact Donate Home Our values Love without limits. In everything we do. Agape is more than our name. It’s how we choose to show up for children, families, and one another. Compassion We serve people with dignity, respect, and understanding. Care begins with listening. We aim to meet children and families where they are, with kindness and respect for their experiences. Empowerment We don’t just help people get through today; we help them prepare for tomorrow. Support should make room for confidence, skills, and independence. Our purpose is to help people see and pursue possibilities for their own futures. Opportunity We believe access can change a life. Education, mentorship, and meaningful resources can open doors. We work to connect people with opportunities that might otherwise feel out of reach. Integrity We lead with honesty, accountability, and transparency. Trust matters in every relationship. We are committed to communicating honestly about our work, our resources, and what is possible. Inclusion Every child, family, and individual deserves to be seen, heard, and valued. Belonging should not depend on background or ability. Accessibility and respect for each person guide the opportunities and relationships we seek to build. Community Lasting change happens when we work together. Families, volunteers, and community partners each bring something valuable. Strong relationships help turn individual acts of care into shared possibility. People at the heart of possibility. When a child is given an opportunity, a family is given hope. And when families become stronger, communities become stronger. Put care into action. Bring your compassion, your experience, and your ideas. Together, we can make room for possibility. pages.text_excerpt: Privacy | Agape Unlimited Foundation Skip to content Agape Unlimited Foundation Our mission What we do Our values Get involved Contact Donate Our mission What we do Our values Get involved Contact Donate Home Privacy Your message, handled with care. Here’s what happens to the information you share through this website. Contact messages The contact form asks for your name, email address, a topic, and a message. You can also provide an organization name. When message delivery is available, this information is sent to the foundation’s configured email inbox through Resend, an email delivery service. This website does not save contact messages to a website database. Messages that are sent may remain in the foundation’s inbox and the email provider’s systems. If you prepare a message but do not send it, the form does not submit that information. Spam protection and technical information The form includes an automated spam check and limits repeated requests. Hosting services may process technical information, including your IP address and request details, to operate the website and prevent abuse. Contact message text is not intentionally written to application logs. Donations Online donation links take you to the foundation’s configured donation provider. Payment information is entered on that provider’s website and handled under its own privacy practices. This website does not collect card numbers or process payments. What to include in a message Please share only what we need to understand your question. Avoid sending passwords, payment information, or sensitive records through the form. Questions about your information Contact the foundation to ask about a message you have sent or request help with your information. Agape Unlimited Foundation Unlimited love. Unlimited possibilities.
